summary: A concurrent runner is added to the job package (module on Go 1.22).

defects.why: Several goroutines write the same map without a lock; the runtime aborts with "concurrent map writes" or the results are corrupted.
Add runs inside the goroutine, so Wait can return before any goroutine has started and Run returns missing results.

decoys.quote:
for _, job := range jobs {

decoys.why: Since Go 1.22, which go.mod declares, each iteration has its own job variable: the closure does not share the last job.
